title: MetaExp: Learning to Self-Improve through Experience via Verifiable Cross-Task Environment Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.21492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents can accumulate interaction feedback, but reliably turning that feedback into reusable experience remains challenging. Existing methods either optimize external experience scaffolds or train experience-related behavior on specific task distributions, leaving open whether experience learning itself can become a transferable model capability. Training such a capability calls for supervision beyond isolated tasks, which mainly support in-episode problem solving rather than revealing what knowledge remains useful across episodes. In this work, we introduce MetaExp, a scalable framework that trains this capability through verifiable task families with controlled cross-task structure. Each family preserves a reusable factor while varying task-specific realizations, enabling transfer without direct solution reuse. translated_title: MetaExp：通过可验证的跨任务环境扩展，学习基于经验的自我提升
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体能够积累交互反馈，但如何可靠地将这些反馈转化为可复用的经验仍然具有挑战性。现有方法要么优化外部经验脚手架，要么在特定任务分布上训练与经验相关的行为，这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：经验学习本身能否成为一种可迁移的模型能力。训练这样一种能力需要超越孤立任务的监督信号，因为孤立任务主要支持回合内的问题求解，而无法揭示哪些知识在跨回合时仍然有用。在本工作中，我们提出了MetaExp，这是一个可扩展的框架，通过具有受控跨任务结构的可验证任务族来训练这种能力。每个任务族在保留一个可复用因子的同时改变任务特定的具体实现，从而在不直接复用解法的情况下实现迁移。我们提出了两种互补的设计：共享工具任务族在任务之间保持黑盒工具固定，以引出（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出MetaExp框架，通过构建具有受控跨任务结构的可验证任务族（如共享工具任务族），将经验学习训练为语言模型可迁移的内在能力，从而实现基于经验的自我提升。
en_tdlr: MetaExp is a scalable framework that turns experience learning into a transferable model capability by training on verifiable task families with controlled cross-task structure (e.g., Shared-Tool families), enabling self-improvement without direct solution reuse.
